title: Content
description: Stores the content for a professional portfolio for a personal website.

person.title: Personal Information
person.description: The individual's personal and professional profile information.

education.title: Education
education.description: A list of academic qualifications, institutions, and educational achievements.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: A list of professional roles, employment history, or relevant work experience.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: A list of professional, technical, and personal skills.

primaryProjects.title: Primary Projects
primaryProjects.description: A list of the individual's most important projects to be displayed by default.

secondaryProjects.title: Secondary Projects
secondaryProjects.description: A list of additional projects to be collapsed by default.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: A list of professional, academic, technical, or industry certifications.

awards.title: Awards
awards.description: A list of awards, honors, professional recognitions, or academic scholarships.

conferences.title: Conferences
conferences.description: A list of conferences, events, symposiums, conventions, or professional gatherings attended.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: A list of spoken, written, or otherwise known languages and related proficiency information.

social.title: Social Links
social.description: A list of social media profiles, professional networks, websites, and other relevant links.
